title: Budget & Investment Planning
short_description: Maximize enterprise capital portfolio net present value, allocate divisible treasury liquidity, rank departmental project ROI, and maximize innovation seed grants.
real_world_context: Corporate finance committees, strategic treasury departments, and enterprise capital investment committees allocate limited annual expenditure budgets across competing investment opportunities. Financial analysts must solve discrete 0/1 Knapsack optimization to select the highest-yielding combination of indivisible enterprise software transformations under strict budget ceilings, use Fractional Knapsack algorithms to apportion continuous corporate cash reserves across interest-bearing liquidity instruments, sort departmental project proposals by Return on Investment (ROI) ratios, and apply greedy funding heuristics to maximize the total number of employee grassroots innovation proposals approved.
learning_objectives: Solve 0/1 Knapsack optimization to maximize capital project Net Present Value (NPV) under fixed corporate budgets.
Implement Fractional Knapsack allocation to maximize investment yield across continuously divisible treasury assets.
Sort project initiatives by Return on Investment (ROI) efficiency ratios using cross-multiplication tie-breaking.
Apply greedy heuristics to maximize the number of funded strategic innovation grant proposals.
Apply Unbounded Knapsack Dynamic Programming to maximize returns from scalable investment vehicles.
